_meta.role: Host registry for RC cross-host dispatch. host-label -> tailscale identity + locality.
_meta.consumer: ai/rc.sh + the /rc-launch skill. A host is LOCAL iff its machine_name == $MACHINE_NAME (set per-box in config.<machine>.zsh). Otherwise dispatch via: ssh <ssh_user>@<tailscale_dns>.
_meta.check: reachability = `tailscale status --json | jq -e '.Peer[]|select(.DNSName|startswith(<hostname>))|.Online'` or ping the tailscale_dns before dispatch.
